title: Enforce the emergency stop at admission and scope it (VC-201-080)
goal: VC-201-080 refuted: register_task never consults the stop — tasks registered after apply_stop run uncancelled while rejects_new_work reports the fleet stopped; scope is a stored label — a region-a stop cancels region-b work; the persisted stop file is unsigned JSON so flipping active:false silently lifts it; EmergencyStopBus has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_080_mastery.rs.
